bug_report: The heartbeat timer never fires: the firmware always prints 'tick timeout'.

agent.root_cause: TIM2_CR1 was incorrectly set to (1u << 1) instead of enabling the counter via CEN (bit 0). (1u << 1) sets the URS bit, not the counter enable bit.
